_about: Shown once on each phone after it installs a new Android update (not on a first install). Replace the list with what this update changes, in plain words, each time an Android update is approved and built.
items: A cleaner look: the pages sit on the plain background, with no frame round them and no line across the top of the bottom panel.
Your logo on Home is a little bigger and keeps its own shape, with no white frame round it.
An empty log’s “No pallets yet” message now runs across the page instead of being squeezed down the side.
The Guide and Changelog have been taken out of the app. The ⋮ menu has Settings, Exported files and About.
